title: Migraine-prone today?
caption: Migraine-prone today? The day has a little wobble to it, and head tightness may flip on and off. Keep screens dim, wear a brim outside, move slow, and space out tasks.
snapshot: Conditions are a bit unsettled rather than calm. The magnetic orientation leans south, with otherwise steady solar wind. No recent solar flares or CMEs were noted.
affects: Migraine or headache sensitivity can show up as on-and-off head tightness. Bright screens, harsh lights, and quick posture changes may feel bigger during peaks. The waves tend to pass when inputs ease.
playbook:
- Lower screen brightness and use night mode
- Wear a brim or shades outdoors
- Take short, eyes-closed pauses in quiet
- Sip water regularly and don’t skip meals
- Keep movements smooth, especially neck and shoulders

fb.caption:
Migraine-prone today? The day has a little wobble to it, and head tightness may flip on and off. The field is tugging south while the overall flow stays steady—an odd mix that can make bright screens, harsh lights, and quick posture changes feel louder. No fresh eruptions to point at, still it isn’t fully calm, so treat inputs like a dimmer, not a switch.

Try a simple hourly reset: lower your screen brightness, close your eyes for 20 slow breaths, and roll your shoulders and neck with smooth, unhurried motion—this trims sensory load and can keep the band-around-the-head feeling from ramping. Wear a brim or shades outside, sip water, and don’t skip meals to avoid trigger stacking. Move between tasks gradually, even if you are not feeling better yet; the waves often pass when the inputs ease. What tiny tweak helps you stay ahead of a rising throb?
